candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes a hyperdense midline mass above the bladder on CT and a hyperechoic mass in the hypogastric region on ultrasound, consistent with a urachal cyst. Intussusception is a different pathological entity (telescoping of bowel) and does not match the imaging findings of a discrete midline cystic/hyperdense mass above the bladder. While intussusception can present with abdominal pain and vomiting in a child, the CT and ultrasound findings here point specifically to a urachal remnant structure, not an intussusception.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Intussusception is a telescoping bowel obstruction; urachal cyst is a midline embryological remnant cyst above the bladder

case_quality_flags: Elevated CRP and rigid abdomen suggest secondary infection/inflammation of the urachal cyst, which may have complicated the clinical picture
